head: d8a8b3d
summary: A qualified producer/verifier pair now exists for disclosed deterministic whole-product renders of the three Launch-0 products. The producer draws one glyph per compiled twin cell on certified gauge geometry; the verifier ignores the manifest and re-measures the exact bytes against compiler-derived expectations. structural_floor PASSes such a frame only on the verifier's PASS on the sha256-bound bytes. The assets.build handler produces, durably files and serves the set; parity PRODUCT_TRUTH and MOBILE_GRID now pass on it. Parity as a whole still blocks on HERO (no vision description), LIFESTYLE_QUALITY (photographic standard, F-221/F-229B/F-856) and COMPETITIVE (no benchmark) -- unchanged gates this work does not answer and does not weaken.

tolerances.extent: +-2% or 6px: outline inset ~1px/side + scale read <0.5px over >=400px; a missing round in a 15-round piece is ~7%
tolerances.pitch: +-4% median of centroid spacings; quantisation <1px on 9-180px pitches
tolerances.off_palette: <=0.1% of pixels (contract renders are unantialiased; any redraw/resample exceeds by orders of magnitude)
tolerances.caption_iou: >=0.98 vs contract wording rendered in the contract face/position

disclosure.wording: Digital rendering of the pattern's finished design, not a photograph
disclosure.why: names the medium (digital rendering), what it shows (the finished design the pattern makes; we sell a pattern, not an object) and what it is not (a photograph). Avoids 'AI'/'generated': no model is in the path and Etsy AI-disclosure wording would misdirect while still not saying it is not a photograph. Matches the spirit of publish.eligibility.RENDER_LABEL.
enforced_in: image pixels (caption IoU check by the verifier)
alt text (starts with the wording; <=500 chars)
listing copy (gates.platform_policy DISCLOSURES['disclosed_render'], written by listing.draft via classify_release(disclosed=...))
disclosure.export_gate: publish.disclosed_listing.export_images is the only exporter for disclosed frames and refuses unless the wording is in pixels, alt text and copy AND structural_floor is PASS on the exact bytes; runtime.etsy_ops.certified_images refuses a disclosed frame (it cannot carry alt text); EtsyClient.publish now carries alt text in (name, bytes, alt_text) entries.

risks: Twin rounds are circular arithmetic; stacked increases are drawn as hexagons with corners on the twin radii, so side pitch is 3/pi (0.955) of gauge and round centreline pitch is 7-11% under gauge width. The listing's across-the-points dimension is honoured exactly. Disclosed in the manifest's modelling_notes.
Basket walls are drawn as a hexagonal prism (geometry.corners=6 on the base); a worked basket may round out. The twin and CIR give no wall-shape evidence beyond this.
Flat rows draw every stitch at its row's height (the twin carries row heights only); a dc is marked as a raised post. Twin is uncalibrated (twin.calibrated False) for all Launch-0.
Disclosed-set build adds ~25-35 s per release to assets.build, dominated by existing pure-Python layout_qa/mobile loops (not changed).
Caption and verifier depend on DejaVuSans (contract font); a missing font makes the render refuse and the verifier UNKNOWN (fail closed).

The commerce.thumbnail THUMB_TEXT check is not applied to the 34px disclosure caption (it is not grid text, per the owner's 'small unobtrusive caption'); recorded in each record's qa.hero_thumbnail.text_check for the integrator to confirm.
